meta.name: The Heights at Uptown — Phase 1
caveats: Monotony adjacency is built from the OCH master address list, not from geometry: lots are ordered along each street by house number, and across-street pairing is same street, opposite side, nearest number. This spans block boundaries correctly (Garrett Parkway runs through blocks U, M and K). 23 of 48 OCH lots have an OCH lot opposite; the rest face non-OCH lots, which never carry an OCH plan and so cannot conflict. An earlier geometry-only derivation disagreed with the addresses on 15 of 23 cases and was discarded.
Driveway slope is an estimate: (pad − rear grade) ÷ 20 ft apron. Six lots estimate over Celina’s 10% max — P-8, P-12, N-5, U-9, X-1, Y-2. Verify each against the alley profile before relying on it.
Retaining wall data covers 27 of 48 OCH lots. Absence of wall data is not evidence there is no wall.
Setbacks (10′ front BL, 5′ porch encroachment) were resolved against OCH-built, City-approved plot plans, which govern over the spec sheet’s 20′.

This dataset holds 227 lots. The recorded plat has 236 residential lots; six more (3,850 sf each, running parallel to Block S) are absent, and the plat itself is internally inconsistent — its lot count table totals 244 while its title block totals 249. None of the absent lots are OCH lots, and only OCH lots ever carry an OCH plan, so no fit, grading, wall or monotony check is affected. Left as-is by decision 9/17/26.

P-8 (501 Callum Parkway) has a 35 x 66 ft pad, the only OCH pad shallower than 80 ft. The shallowest plan needs 69.5 ft after the 5 ft porch credit, so NO current plan fits P-8 on pad depth. P-8 is also flagged at ~15% estimated driveway slope. Verify against the grading sheet before offering this lot.
meta.addressSource: OCH master address list (block/lot → address), 48/48 OCH lots
meta.streetSource: Street names and positions from the recorded plat DWG (20241219-Heights_at_Uptown_Phase_1_FP.dwg) via LibreDWG, transformed by x-2493533.1 / y-7171672.4 (exact, zero residual). COLTON MEWS is the one exception: it is not a text entity in the DWG, so its label was placed from lot Y-2 and is approximate.
meta.orientation: North is UP. The plat DWG uses survey coordinates (y increases north) while SVG draws y downward, so the extracted geometry was vertically mirrored. Flipped 9/17/26 about y=1437.0. Grand Oaks was already correct and was not touched.
meta.padSource: Building pads from the engineer's grading drawing (Grading - Heights at Uptown Phase 1 - 12/19/24, layers C-BLDG-35x80 (45) and C-BLDG-25x80 (35)), read via LibreDWG. Same coordinate system as the plat, so the same transform applies. These are ACTUAL pad locations, not derived from setbacks. All 48 OCH lots have exactly one pad, every one 35.0 ft wide — independently confirming the 35 ft buildable width derived from the setbacks.
